name: Email Verification API
short_description: Validate email addresses with syntax, DNS/MX, disposable-domain, role-based and optional SMTP checks in one fast request.
long_description: Email Verification API helps you catch bad addresses before they reach your database. Send one address or a batch and get a stable status, a 0-100 confidence score, a plain-language reason and a detailed check breakdown covering syntax, domain resolution, MX records, disposable domains, role-based local parts and optional SMTP probing. Use it for signup validation, lead-list cleaning, CRM hygiene and fraud reduction.
hosting_provider: Any Docker host with public HTTPS (Railway, Render, Fly.io, VPS + Caddy)
auth_headers: X-RapidAPI-Proxy-Secret (injected by RapidAPI at the gateway; validated by the backend)
pricing_note: Suggested launch pricing only. Confirm costs, adjust prices/quotas in RapidAPI Studio and update website/index.html to match before publishing.

endpoints.name: Verify a single email address
endpoints.description: Run syntax, DNS/MX, disposable, role and optional SMTP checks on one address.

endpoints.name: Verify multiple email addresses
endpoints.description: Verify up to MAX_BULK_EMAILS addresses (100 by default) and return per-item results plus a summary.

endpoints.name: Health check
endpoints.description: Return service status and version. Use as the RapidAPI health check.

launch_checklist: Deploy the API behind public HTTPS with a valid certificate.
Replace https://your-domain.example and support@your-domain.example in website/index.html, website/terms.html, website/privacy.html, openapi.json and this file.
Open /, /terms and /privacy in a browser and confirm they render.
Paste the RapidAPI proxy secret into RAPIDAPI_PROXY_SECRET and redeploy.
Verify GET /api/v1/health returns 200 with the proxy secret configured.
Import openapi.json into RapidAPI Studio and set the base URL.
Create Basic, Pro and Ultra plans and align limits with website/index.html.
Set the Website, Terms of use and support contact fields in Hub Listing.
Run the RapidAPI endpoint tester for both verify endpoints.
Publish, then test with a real consumer key from a clean client.
notes: SMTP checking is disabled by default because many mail providers block or rate-limit probes. Keep it opt-in.
The disposable-domain list is static; refresh app/data/disposable_domains.py periodically.
The backend does not store submitted email addresses as a contact database.
RapidAPI enforces plan quotas and billing. The backend's own auth is an extra gateway check, not a billing system.
